backend/main.mo: Actor implementing user onboarding, profile management, balances, order handling, and authorization checks using AccessControl and MixinAuthorization.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module copying old actor state fields directly into the new actor format without transformations.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to related frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of various frontend files including pages, components, hooks, and utilities.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base and theme variable definitions providing light/dark OKLCH color tokens and global styling.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML document mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router with routes for main pages including login, signup, dashboard, profile, admin, and status.
frontend/src/components/AdminDiagnostics: UI card showing admin diagnostics including admin status, wallet state, and admin token checks using various hooks.
frontend/src/components/AppFooter.tsx: Footer with referral link sharing, copy-to-clipboard button, credits link, and site attribution.
frontend/src/components/AppHeader.tsx: Header component showing logo and login/profile button, and updates a CSS offset based on its height.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Main layout wrapper that initializes onboarding for authenticated users and renders background, balance indicator, and routed content.
frontend/src/components/BalanceIndicator: Displays user and optional admin wallet balances with refresh and error handling, or a login prompt if unauthenticated.
frontend/src/components/OrderConfirmatio: Shows order confirmation details including package info, price, video URL, and links to order status or creating a new order.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor and invalidates related queries when it changes.
Derives admin wallet UI state based on identity, actor readiness, and admin balance query results.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUrl.ts: Returns the current browser URL after component mount.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context, handling login, logout, stored identities, and login state tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useOrders.ts: Provides hooks for creating orders through the backend actor and fetching an order by ID with cache updates.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for user profiles, balances, admin checks, and admin wallet operations, all keyed per identity. Handles auth state, retries, and error conditions.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers, CSS variables for themes, and utility classes for safe-area fixed positioning.
frontend/src/lib/backendError.ts: Normalizes backend errors into readable messages and detects authorization-related errors.
frontend/src/lib/copyToClipboard.ts: Implements text copy functionality using the Clipboard API with a fallback for older browsers.
frontend/src/lib/format.ts: Formats timestamps, order IDs, PKR amounts, and bigint balances for display.
frontend/src/lib/packages.ts: Exports a list of predefined service packages with prices, descriptions, and benefits.
frontend/src/lib/queryKeys.ts: Centralizes React Query key generation for actors, balances, profiles, and admin state, scoped by principal.
frontend/src/lib/validation.ts: Validates user-provided URLs, ensuring they are non-empty and properly formatted.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard for viewing wallet status and performing top-ups and fund distribution with retry logic.
frontend/src/pages/AdminUsersPage.tsx: Admin page that lists all users, checks admin access, and supports copying principal IDs.
frontend/src/pages/CreditsPage.tsx: Displays a credits page with project details, features, contact links, and an educational-use disclaimer.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Provides a dashboard for viewing user balance and allowing admins to distribute funds with validation and notifications.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Home screen for selecting service packages, submitting a video URL, and creating an order with confirmation flow.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Handles Internet Identity login, redirects after authentication, and shows loading, login, or logged‑in states.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Displays and edits user profile details with image upload, validation, and save functionality tied to Internet Identity.
frontend/src/pages/SignUpPage.tsx: Sign-up page that triggers Internet Identity login, redirects authenticated users to profile setup, and shows loading or already-authenticated states.
frontend/src/pages/StatusPage.tsx: Fetches and displays order status by ID with loading, error, and success states using UI cards and badges.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading URL parameters, persisting them in sessionStorage, and cleaning parameters from URL hashes.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending colors, typography, animations, and container settings with custom themes and plugins.
project_state.json: Project state file describing known issues, existing features, and new feature requests related to login visibility and wallet/balance behavior.
